name: Losslessly packed BF16 lm_head with recursive source/binary overlay
hypothesis: A source-hash-bound PR checkout plus ABI-compatible wheel extensions can reproduce the exact packed lm_head path without reinstalling vLLM, while persistent sessions amortize engine startup.
expected_global_effect: Reduce batch-one decode latency without changing the GPTQ backbone, attention, scheduler, sampling, vocabulary, checkpoint values, or binary extension build.

preserved_dependencies: the original BF16 weight remains loaded and is the fallback source
the auxiliary representation reconstructs every original BF16 weight bit
the GPTQ backbone, attention, scheduler, vocabulary and greedy sampling stay unchanged
the installed binary wheel supplies extensions only; Python behavior comes from the sealed PR source
changed_boundaries: eligible BF16 lm_head weights receive a non-persistent auxiliary layout after loading
nested vLLM packages search the sealed source tree before the ABI-compatible binary wheel
prohibited_rewrites: no quantization, approximation, vocabulary shortlist, speculative decoding, skipped work or changed sampling
dependency_contract.numerical_ordering: The weight representation is bit-exact, while the legal FP32 accumulation tree can differ; exact greedy token identity is required on every sealed case.

evidence.claim: The worker rejects any drift in the exact PR implementation files before engine initialization.
